test.title: Issue27 repaired body model: every twelfth literal chunk

tokenization.rowTraversal: Existing conventional source order, page then frozen region then physical row; no row, region, page or paragraph reset.
tokenization.keepChunkPredicate: Contains at least one ASCII A-Z, a-z or 0-9, tested before wrapper stripping.
tokenization.stripRule: Repeatedly remove only members of outerWrapperCharacters from the beginning and end. Do not remove any interior character. Retain the remaining chunk exactly.
literalRetentions: All hyphens, including physical row-ending hyphens
All slash characters, including a row-ending slash
Currency symbols, including a leading dollar sign
forbidden: Punctuation deletion beyond the registered outer-wrapper rule

selection.rule: For the direction-specific token sequence T, select T[p], T[p+12], T[p+24], ... while in range. Reverse means reverse the entire token sequence before applying this rule. No other reset or reversal.

projections.words: Join selected cleaned chunks in order with exactly one U+0020 ASCII space.
projections.initials: Concatenate the first remaining Unicode character of every selected cleaned chunk.
projections.finals: Concatenate the last remaining Unicode character of every selected cleaned chunk.

policy.projectionTerminology: Initials/finals are literal first/last core glyphs, not inferred linguistic word letters. Thus final hyphens, censor stars and slash characters remain possible. This is one declared model, not a test of all linguistic letter policies.

sourceUncertainty.executionModel: Execute the single frozen repaired-OCR model, retaining the unchanged prior strings in the three uncertain leading-word spans. No branch over alternative spellings.

uncertainTokens.physicalChunk: First chunk containing ASCII alphanumeric characters in that row
uncertainTokens.uncertainty: Leading glyph/prefix not source-certified; word boundary/count and terminal glyph are source-certified by the independent third review.

uncertainTokens.physicalChunk: First chunk containing ASCII alphanumeric characters in that row
uncertainTokens.uncertainty: Leading glyph/prefix not source-certified; word boundary/count and terminal glyph are source-certified by the independent third review.

uncertainTokens.physicalChunk: First chunk containing ASCII alphanumeric characters in that row
uncertainTokens.uncertainty: Leading glyph/prefix not source-certified; word boundary/count and terminal glyph are source-certified by the independent third review.

sourceUncertainty.executionModelComplete: True after all finite declared readings are evaluated against the pinned model, regardless of source uncertainty.
sourceUncertainty.physicalSourceComplete: For words and initials, true only if selected token positions avoid all three uncertain-prefix tokens. For finals, true because all relevant final glyphs, including l/e/s for these three tokens, are source-certified. Record the projection-specific rule without guessing the unknown prefixes.
sourceUncertainty.negativeLanguage: No strict-format lead in the 72 readings of this frozen repaired-OCR model. Separately report how many readings used no uncertain token; source-affected readings cannot exclude the corresponding physical-source reading.
sourceUncertainty.hitLanguage: Any words/initials lead involving an uncertain-prefix token depends on the provisional OCR spelling and needs source confirmation before significance is assigned. A finals reading uses only source-certified terminal glyphs; this certifies its input glyphs, not the cryptographic hypothesis.
sourceUncertainty.punctuationOnlyUncertainty: The p79 leading elision quote before til is removed regardless of its curly orientation because both U+2018 and U+2019 are in the fixed wrapper set. A standalone en/em dash after day has no ASCII alphanumeric and is not a counted token in this declared model. Neither requires a model branch.
sourceUncertainty.finalGlyphEvidence: Root reports an independent blinded third source review visibly certifying the final glyphs l/e/s of the three affected words. This proposal accepts that explicit source receipt; the earlier page81 review conservatively left row3 final-glyph evidence unresolved.

parameters.phaseMeaning: Offset phase-1 into the direction-specific full token array, then every twelfth token. Reverse means reverse all tokens before selection.
parameters.strictKnownSubset: Filter whole readings whose selected tokens are source-complete for their projection; never omit selected tokens or join across omitted tokens.
parameters.uncertainty: Only first kept chunk in p4:col1_top:2/3/4 is uncertain for words and initials; its finals l/e/s are source-certified.

test.negativeCriterion: A complete zero result excludes only four literal formats in the 72 declared readings of the single frozen repaired-OCR model. Separately report the whole-reading subset with source-complete projection inputs. Never call the whole physical-source hypothesis negative.
limitations: Stride12 is exploratory, motivated by the duplicated printed 12-step passage; no creator instruction is authenticated.
Conventional body-row order, whitespace chunks and the exact wrapper set are declared model assumptions.
Three unchanged low-confidence leading words remain provisional for words and initials; no alternative spelling is tried. Finals use source-certified terminal glyphs.
No hard-wrap joins, linguistic letter policy, case variants, page resets, other populations, arbitrary encodings or downstream key use are tested.
Minikey checksum evidence is weak and hex64 scalar range has no checksum. Any positive is private review only.
